name: Sin Fetish Audio
author: Sin Fetish Audio
tagline: Earth Creature Beats: Otter, Cat, Fox, Hopper and the Beaver, together
description: A groovebox of five creatures: Otter Synth (32 presets, arp), Cat Kit (sample drums, 3 kits), Fox Bass & 808 (16 one-shots + 8 synth basses), Hopper Cut (slicer, samples the output), Beaver (4-lane sequencer, patterns A-D). MIDI channels 1-4 play Otter, Cat, Fox, Hopper.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
